THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
STREET & CITY
196
STUDY 172
Blue Lace-Trim Tank & Low-Rise Jeans
Rights check
Source: 25066.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with wavy, sun-kissed blonde
hair leans against a textured blue wall. She wears a
pale blue ribbed tank with a scalloped lace neckline and
lace trim at the hem. Multiple silver necklaces hang at
her chest, and a silver stud sits at her ear. Low-rise
faded denim jeans with decorative pocket detailing and
a studded belt complete the look. Her expression is
calm and direct. Warm, natural daylight. Palette of
powder blue, faded denim, and soft cream lace.
Nostalgic and relaxed, in the style of a 1990s film
portrait.
Nostalgic, relaxed, sun-washed
WORKING NOTES
- The lace-trimmed tank and layered necklaces are the
defining details.
- Keep the textured blue wall for a bold, graphic backdrop.
